citations.assessment: The name is Acha bar Chana and the reported authority is Rav Sheshet. Bar Tachlifa appears in a separate response.
The retrieved Menachot text names Rabbah bar bar Chana and alternatively Acha bar bar Chana, both reporting Yochanan. The doubled bar occurs in both of the latter two folios.
The cooking discussion likewise varies Rabbah and Acha, with bar bar in both readings.
